# opnsense_monit_service (Resource)

Services monitored by Monit (**Services ▸ Monit ▸ Settings ▸ Service Settings**), each checked against a set of tests.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_monit_service" "system" {
  name  = "firewall"
  type  = "system"
  tests = [opnsense_monit_test.high_cpu.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the service.
- `type` (String) What is monitored.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address to check, for `host` services.
- `depends` (Set of String) UUIDs of the services this one depends on. Defaults to `[]`.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this service is monitored. Defaults to `true`.
- `interface` (String) Interface to check, for `network` services.
- `match` (String) Process name pattern, for `process` services without a PID file.
- `path` (String) Path to monitor, or the script for `custom` services.
- `pidfile` (String) PID file of the process, for `process` services.
- `polltime` (String) Polling interval, e.g. `every 2 cycles`.
- `start` (String) Command used to start the service.
- `start_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for the service to start. Defaults to `30`.
- `stop` (String) Command used to stop the service.
- `tests` (Set of String) UUIDs of the tests applied to this service. Defaults to `[]`.
- `timeout` (Number) Script timeout in seconds, for `custom` services. Defaults to `300`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Monit service.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_monit_service using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_monit_service.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_monit_service using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_monit_service.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
